findings.passage: For this reason, we desperately need and urge Congress to waive the filibuster and take action before another child is killed. There are sensible gun laws, supported by a majority of Americans, that Congress can pass quickly, including reinstating a ban on assault-style weapons or limiting high-capacity magazines. The Senate can immediately pass H.R. 8 to address background check requirements.
findings.note: Joint statement issued by six House members including Ruiz after the Uvalde school shooting. Urges Congress to reinstate an assault-style weapons ban or limit high-capacity magazines, and to pass H.R. 8 on background checks. Shared statement, not Ruiz alone.

findings.passage: In Oregon, we’ve passed legislation that requires background checks, prohibits guns on public school grounds, makes extreme risk protection orders available, and ensures the secure storage of firearms. We are committed to taking bold action during the next legislative session in 2023 to further prevent these types of tragedies from happening.
findings.note: Same joint statement. Cites Oregon's existing background check, school-grounds, extreme risk order and secure storage laws and commits to further action in the 2023 session.
